rules.heading: 1926.100 Head protection.
rules.text: 1926.100 Head protection. (Personal protective equipment). (a) Employees working in areas where there is a possible danger of head injury from impact, or from falling or flying objects, or from electrical shock and burns, shall be protected by protective helmets.
